tabs.title: Overview
tabs.lead: You hold the Penghu islands. No help is coming. /nChina attacks from the sea and from the air. /nYour job is to last as long as you can. /nChina wins when none of your ground units remain on the islands. /nAircraft and ships do not hold an island. Only ground units do: /infantry /tank /artillery /aa_pickup /aaw /truck. /nDo not give up inhabited islands without a fight. Your lookouts sit on them. /nChina sends landing ships /landing_ship_c, infantry /infantry_c, scouts /scout_c, and kamikaze drones /drone_c. /nForest hides you. Open ground is seen from far away. /nThe rest of this manual covers the camera, orders, fire, vision, messages, and ferries.
notes: Pause with /esc or the /pause button on the right. Pause does not quit the game.
This manual opens with /f1 or the /help button.

tabs.title: Camera
tabs.lead: To pan the camera, use /W /A /S /D or the arrow keys. You can also hold /lmb on empty ground and drag. /nTo zoom, use /Q /E or /wheel. /nTo open pause, use /esc or /pause. /nTo switch radar mode, use /R. /nTo return the view to Penghu, press /home or /C.

shots.caption: Speed: /f2 /f3 /f4 /f5 or the buttons on the bar. 0× stops time.
/R or the VIEW MODE buttons: /map map and /radar radar.

notes: /esc opens pause. The game does not quit.

tabs.title: Units
tabs.lead: To select a unit or clear the selection, use /lmb. To add another unit, use /shift + /lmb. /nTo select a group, hold /shift + /lmb and drag a box. /nTo move a unit, use /rmb. /nTo add a waypoint, use /shift + /rmb. That works only for sea /ferry and air /drone. /nGround units do not walk on water. A new /rmb sets a new path.

shots.caption: The UNITS window. Uncheck a kind to hide it on the map. The units themselves stay in the world.

notes: You can drag the UNITS window by its title.
Air, Land, Sea, and Static branches open with the arrow on the left.

tabs.title: Warfare
tabs.lead: The RANGE window draws weapon reach for /infantry /aa_pickup /tank /aaw /artillery. /n/G hides every RANGE ring or brings them back. /nThe TARGETS window appears when a shooter is selected. /n FIRE — the battery shoots on its own, using the filter. /n HOLD — it stays silent until you switch back to FIRE. /nCheckboxes in TARGETS pick who you may hit: /drone_c /scout_c /landing_ship_c /infantry_c and the other kinds. /n AIM, PICK, and CLR exist only on /artillery. /n AIM — the next /lmb on the map sets the impact point. CLR clears that point. /n PICK — click /lmb on specific enemies. A box works too. /n/shift + PICK clears that list. /n/rmb cancels AIM, PICK, or a port and ferry command. /nArtillery fires only while standing still. /nA unit heals on its own if it is idle and was not hit recently. Full health takes two in-game days. /nAmmunition does not refill.

shots.caption: TARGETS. HOLD and FIRE, plus filters for Air, Land, Sea, and Static.
/artillery only: AIM on the map, scatter ring. PICK marks priority targets.

notes: Healing does not run while the unit is moving or was just hurt.

tabs.title: Intel
tabs.lead: You see what your sensors see. China sees the same with its own. /nThe VISION window draws sight rings. Primitive is the naked eye. Advanced is long optics, like /scout_c. /nOpen ground is seen farthest. Grass is closer. Forest is closer still and hides better. /nThe /sat icon at the top right is China's satellite. /nGreen /sat: the satellite is looking. Red /sat_red: the satellite is silent. A timer sits next to it. /nWhile it looks, it sees vehicles and ships on open ground and in grass. /nIt does not see infantry /infantry. /nNobody is seen from orbit in forest. /nWhile /sat is green, a SPOTTED notice from /drone_c or /scout_c comes only from forest. /nAn island is yours while your ground units stand on it. /nIf only Chinese ground units are on it, the island is theirs. /port and /airfield go with it. /nAir /drone /scout and sea /ferry /ship do not hold an island. /nA lost inhabited island is also a lost lookout.

shots.caption: VISION. Open ground is on by default. Turn on grass and forest yourself.
/sat on the right of the bar. The timer is how long the window stays open, or when it opens again.
The island changes colour when none of your ground units remain and Chinese ground units are there.

tabs.title: Messages
tabs.lead: The CONTACTS journal sits at the bottom right. /n CONTACT — you first saw an enemy: /drone_c /scout_c /landing_ship_c /ship_c. /n SPOTTED — their /drone_c or /scout_c sees you. /n LOSSES — one of yours was wrecked. /n AMMO — magazines are nearly gone, or already empty. /n SAT — the satellite /sat came up or /sat_red went down. /n THEATER — an island was taken or retaken, or a landing /landing_ship_c is under way. /n LIFT — a /ferry load or unload. /nClick a line to send the camera to the event. /n SET opens filters: what to show, and whether to drop speed to 1× or 0×. /n WIN undocks the window. DOCK pins it back.

shots.caption: CONTACTS. SET is settings. WIN and DOCK free the window or pin it.
In SET, each type has chat visibility, speed OFF / 1× / 0×, and icon filters.

tabs.title: Sea
tabs.lead: A /ferry carries ground units only: /infantry /tank /artillery /aa_pickup /aaw /truck. /nSelect your /port and Launch, then /lmb on water — a hull leaves the port stock. /n Recall, then /lmb on your /ferry — an empty hull returns to stock. A port holds up to 20 hulls. /nSelect a /ferry: Load and /lmb on your ground unit to embark. Unload and /lmb on a shore or your /port to disembark. /nA /bridge: select it and Destroy. Without the bridge, ground units cannot walk the strait.

shots.caption: /port: Launch on water, Recall on your /ferry. Hull stock shows on the port.
/ferry: Load — click your unit. Unload — click the shore or a port.
/bridge. Destroy breaks it at once. Ground units can no longer walk the strait.

notes: Clicking the same port or ferry command again cancels it.
/rmb also cancels the command in this mode.
